title: Church leaders: Systems Thinking
description: Church leaders  See the church's own decline systemically.
content:
## Church leaders

See the church's own decline systemically. Much of what presents as spiritual decline was preceded by middle-class decline, individualized risk, and rising inequality squeezing the institutions that grew from healthier economic soil. Systemic responses belong on the church's agenda: transit, pedestrian, and bike access to campus and high-quality land use; pathways to household formation for young families; addressing real structural inequities in vocational training and higher education; job placement and career development as ministry. The church that tends the soil will not need to force the growth.
